proof_body:
by
  intro a p _ h m
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N + p), a k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 p, a k + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, a k := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero => simp
    | succ N ih =>
      rw [show N + 1 + p = N + p + 1 by ring, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), show N + p + 1 = N + 1 + p by ring, h (N + 1) (by omega)]
      ring
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [show p * (m + 1) = p * m + p by ring, key, ih]
    push_cast
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ), 1 ≤ p → (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + p) = a n) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (p * m), a k = (m : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 p, a k
